newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1996 ethylene output to top 3.0 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China 1996 ethylene output to top 3.0 mln tonnes.

text.p: China will produce more than 3.0 million tonnes of ethylene this year, the official Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
It gave no figure for output in 1995 but said annual capacity had risen to 3.7 million tonnes from 2.3 million tonnes last year.
The news agency linked higher capacity to renovation of existing plants and the construction of a number of new facilities.
China Petrochemical Corp (Sinopec) accounted for 2.45 million tonnes of the nation's total capacity of 3.7 million tonnes, it said.
Sinopec has said it plans to double its ethylene production capacity to around five million tonnes a year by the end of the century.
